newsitem.title: UK: UK carer tax break to cost 1.2 bln stg - Major.
newsitem.headline: UK carer tax break to cost 1.2 bln stg - Major.

text.p: A proposed tax break for those who choose to stay at home to take care of children or sick relatives would cost 1.2 billion pounds a year, British Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday.

He told BBC radio that the proposal, to be unveiled later in the day as part of the ruling Conservative party's manifesto, would take priority over plans to reduce the basic tax rate to 20 percent from the current 23 percent.
"It's going to cost about 1.2 billion (pounds)...The Treasury have looked very carefully at that," he said, adding that higher estimates mentioned in some newspapers were mistaken.
"That is a commitment and it's a commitment which will take priority over other tax cutting objectives...it is a commitment and it is a commitment that is affordable," he said.
Major said the tax break would not be introduced until the second year of a new Conservative government.
His party trails well behind the opposition Labour party ahead of the May 1 election.
